title: H.E.A.T.
description: A hyper optimized real time raycasting solution for audio spatialization in 3D environments.
detailedDescription:
In this group project, I programmed the mechanics of our multiplayer first person shooter game 'HEAT'.
I implemented the player movement, complex gun mechanics and the attachment/upgrades system.
I think i managed to do this quite nicely with set recoil patterns, bloom and noticeable differences between hip and ads firing modes.
In this Project I spent a lot of time getting the 'feel' of the guns just right. I made a very, VERY big and complex scriptable object for the gun.
Because of this, any small thing could be changed per weapon or attachment.
